tests.title: Works with the example sequence
tests.fail_why: Falla la secuencia del enunciado (orden de evicción incorrecto).
tests.fail_how: Cada get y cada put actualizan 'más reciente'. Evicta siempre al menos reciente cuando size > capacity.
tests.fail_why_en: The statement's sequence fails (wrong eviction order).
tests.fail_how_en: Every get and every put refresh 'most recent'. Always evict the least recent one when size > capacity.

tests.title: put on an existing key updates value and recency
tests.fail_why: Al hacer put sobre una clave existente no actualizaste el valor o no la marcaste como reciente.
tests.fail_how: Con LinkedHashMap(accessOrder=true), put sobre una clave existente ya la mueve al final. Si lo haces a mano, quita y vuelve a insertar.
tests.fail_why_en: When calling put on an existing key you did not update the value or did not mark it as recent.
tests.fail_how_en: With LinkedHashMap(accessOrder=true), put on an existing key already moves it to the end. If you do it by hand, remove and insert again.

tests.title: Works with capacity 1
tests.fail_how: Revisa la evicción: insertar antes de evictar puede dejar size = capacity + 1 un instante; evicta cuando size > capacity.
tests.fail_how_en: Check eviction: inserting before evicting can leave size = capacity + 1 for an instant; evict when size > capacity.

tests.title: O(1) operations: 300,000 operations on a 50,000-entry cache
tests.fail_why: Tu estructura hace get/put en O(n) (por ejemplo buscar o mover en una lista).
tests.fail_how: HashMap + lista doblemente enlazada, o LinkedHashMap(16, 0.75f, true) sobrescribiendo removeEldestEntry: get y put en O(1).
tests.fail_why_en: Your structure does get/put in O(n) (for example searching or moving inside a list).
tests.fail_how_en: HashMap + doubly linked list, or LinkedHashMap(16, 0.75f, true) overriding removeEldestEntry: get and put in O(1).
